answer: Every identity starts by locking an NFT held as collateral as a slashable bond, so creating one costs real money. Proof of running a cluster of identities off one wallet comes from funding-flow graph analysis. The penalty follows at once: the challenger who proved the fault keeps the slashed funds. The wharf is where slashable funds wait for a verdict. No basalt hides a shared bond: funding flows are public. The ivory keeps the door closed to anyone unwilling to risk funds.
